en: The postcard features a sepia-toned panoramic view of a town with a river and hills in the background. The foreground shows many houses with pitched roofs, trees, and industrial chimneys. In the background, you can see large buildings near the river. The caption printed on the card reads 'UDDEVALLA FRÅN KÅLGÅRDSBERGET.' There is handwritten text in the lower right portion of the image.
